questionText: A transparent square sheet shown above is folded along the dotted line. The folded sheet will look like ________.
explanation:
Step-by-step solution:

1. Folding Operation: The left half of the transparent sheet is folded horizontally over the right half along the central vertical dotted line.

2. Reflection of Curves: The curve on the left side, when reflected horizontally, superimposes onto the curve on the right side to form a symmetrical lens-like (leaf) shape.

3. Reflection of Marks: The small vertical ticks on the left curve flip horizontally to meet the existing ticks on the right curve, creating chevron/V-shaped markings inside the lens.

4. Conclusion: This resulting pattern correctly matches Option B.
